summary: Use runtime iterator semantics for Math.sumPrecise and preserve precision, signed zero, and IteratorClose.

target.notes: GetIterator(sync); reject non-Number elements without coercion; close on abrupt completion; handle infinities/NaN; preserve all-minus-zero; use precision-safe summation.

semantics.element_coercion: none; every yielded value must already be Number
semantics.precision: mathematical sum rounded once to Number

caveats: A naive double accumulator is not equivalent.
Generic iterator protocol remains owned by ITERATORS_GENERATORS; this rule consumes it.
